title: Design System: Daniel Alyoshin — Personal Site

display.purpose: Engraved rack nameplate and CRT titles; Archivo at width 125, weight 800, uppercase.

label.purpose: All chassis labels; tracked uppercase, never glowing.

osd.purpose: VT323 screen chrome only — PLAY, counters, prompts. Never chassis text.

screen-title.purpose: CRT project titles; tube-scaled (7.5cqi) and capped at the display step.

screen-body.purpose: CRT prose; tube-scaled (4.6cqi) and capped at the body step.

shadows.name: shadow-unit

shadows.name: edge-lit
shadows.purpose: Machined lit top edge on raised panels.

shadows.name: shadow-recess-deep
shadows.purpose: The tape slot mouth and dark cavities.

shadows.purpose: Idle CRT blue bloom — the page's light source (One Light Rule exception).

components.name: Eject Button
components.description: Chassis control: silkscreen caps on a raised ink panel; hover lifts the surface, never glows.

narrative.overview: A dim, precise edit suite. The page is a piece of high-end AV equipment — a matte graphite rack holding a shelf of VHS cassettes, a tape deck, and a CRT — rendered as crisp, contemporary flat vectors. The retro lives entirely in the subject matter; the execution is modern, machined, and clean. The single governing physical fact: the room is dark and the CRT is the only thing emitting light.
keyCharacteristics: Matte graphite chassis, machined seams, silkscreen labels
The CRT emits; nothing else glows
Saturated color arrives only through artifacts (cassette labels, screen output)
Crisp flat SVG/CSS vectors; no photographic grunge, no wear

rules.name: The One Light Rule
rules.body: The CRT is the page's only light source. Glow exists only inside the screen and as the screen's controlled cast onto the deck below it. Chassis text, buttons, and edges never glow. Focus indicators are crisp 2px VFD-cyan outlines, not halos.

rules.name: The Artifact Color Rule
rules.body: Saturated hues belong to content objects, driven by per-project data. The chassis never exceeds graphite + VFD cyan, and VFD cyan stays under ~5% of any viewport.

rules.name: The Silkscreen Rule
rules.body: Chassis hierarchy comes from weight, width, and spacing — never from glow, color, or size inflation.

rules.name: The Tube-Scale Rule
rules.body: Type inside the CRT scales with the tube, not the viewport: .crtUnit is an inline-size container and every screen-interior size is a cqi clamp capped at its documented step. The title focus cue is a 3px OSD-white underline, never an outline box.

dos: Do keep every retro effect (scanlines, flicker, curvature, phosphor, static) clipped inside the CRT screen plane.
Do drive cassette accent colors from project content data — the shelf's color story is the portfolio's color story.
Do give every animated sequence a reduced-motion equivalent that swaps states instantly; prefers-reduced-motion support is non-negotiable.
Do keep prose legibility above the metaphor: Screen Text ≥ 4.5:1 over Screen Black under all effect layers.
donts: Don't age anything: no grunge, sepia, dust, tape damage, or noise textures on chassis or content.
Don't glow outside the screen: no neon edges, no glowing chassis text, no colored halos on hover (The One Light Rule).
Don't use VT323 for chassis text or paragraphs — OSD chrome only.
Don't let the chassis compete with the artifacts: no saturated fields, gradients, or decorative color on rack surfaces.
